args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy (error rate ~18%, unhealthy in us-east, us-west, eu-west). Action taken: rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollout reported VERIFIED; all three regions now on v2.3.0. v2.3.1 remains unhealthy and needs investigation before any redeploy. v2.3.1-rc was unhealthy in staging and was not involved in production.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), and the rollout was verified.

- **Why v2.3.0:** It is the most recent release that was healthy in production. v2.3.1 is unhealthy in production, and v2.3.1-rc was only deployed to staging.
- **Incident:** I opened SEV2 incident INC-0001 for checkout-api. It describes the failure (about 18% error rate after the v2.3.1 deploy), the rollback to v2.3.0, and that v2.3.1 needs investigation before it is redeployed. It paged the on-call engineer.

I did not re-check the service health after the rollback, so confirm the error rate has dropped.

content.text: The most recent release that was healthy in production is v2.3.0 (v2.3.1 is unhealthy in production, and v2.3.1-rc was only in staging). I'll roll back to v2.3.0.
